usedFor: KarmaCRM holds deals and contacts, and Google Docs gets a document when “New Deal Created” runs “Create Document From Text”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Deal Created” in KarmaCRM, then “Create Document From Text” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each new deal gets a titled Google Doc, optionally saved to a chosen folder.

watchOut: KarmaCRM triggers are polling, so the document appears after a scheduled check.
